_comment: MOCK CVE database for the Cehpoint assessment. A few OpenSSH entries modelled on public advisories, abbreviated and simplified (upstream version ranges only; distribution backports are not modelled). Verify against NVD / the vendor before relying on any entry. search_cve never queries a live service.

cves.summary: Signal handler race condition in sshd ("regreSSHion"): an unauthenticated remote attacker may achieve code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems.
PKCS#11 feature in ssh-agent has an insufficiently trustworthy search path; remote code execution if an agent is forwarded to an attacker-controlled system.
SSH transport protocol prefix truncation ("Terrapin"): a man-in-the-middle can drop messages at the start of the secure channel and downgrade connection security.
ssh client: OS command injection may occur if a user or host name contains shell metacharacters and is referenced by an expansion token in certain situations.
sshd fails to initialize supplemental groups when running AuthorizedKeysCommand / AuthorizedPrincipalsCommand as a different user (non-default configuration), allowing privilege escalation.
